# chr.jamie-mother — provenance

**Original work for Last Light.** Every vertex, weight, shape key, clip and texture of Jamie's mother is generated by the
scripts in `tools/blender/supportcast/` (`chr_head.py`, `chr_body.py`, `chr_hair.py`, `chr_tex.py`, `chr_rig.py`,
`build_jamie_mother.py`) with Blender 5.1.2 as a Python module (`bpy`), numpy and Pillow. No scan, photograph, purchased or
downloaded character, base mesh (MakeHuman or otherwise), Sketchfab model, celebrity likeness or generated image was used.
The build is deterministic: the same scripts give the same files.

| Part | How it was made |
|---|---|
| Head | an implicit surface (smooth unions of anatomical volumes) sampled on a radial quad grid, relaxed on the surface; eye openings and the mouth line cut into the grid; lid margins, the mouth's interior, teeth and ears built procedurally |
| Body and clothing | lofted cross-sections (torso, T-shirt with rib neckband and set-in sleeves, mid-rise bootcut jeans with the pants topology, arms, hands with nails, slip-on canvas shoes); no body is kept under the clothes |
| Hair | a shell over the scalp flowing to the elastic, clump ribbons, a ponytail (core, ribbons, elastic) and lash strips |
| Textures | generated in numpy: the face painted from each texel's 3D position on the head (no photo), the hair strands, cotton jersey, denim twill, canvas, the eye |
| Rig, weights, keys, clips | a 65-bone skeleton named after Astra's Phase 1B protagonist rig; chain-based weights; 30 ARKit-style face keys from displacement fields; six clips keyed from a pose solver |

**Design inputs (not copied):** the Prologue spec `CAST.mom` in `dist/cast.js` (skin `0xd6a57f`, iris `0x3a2a1c`, hair
`0x6b4a2a`, shirt `0x9c3b3b`, jeans `0x3d4a66`, shoes `0x2f2f33`), the Character Canon (§2.1 proportions, §4.3), and the
family-resemblance notes of Jamie's Phase 1A design report (round cheek pads, warm brown eyes, warm skin). Jamie's editable
Phase 1A source (Astra's `chr.jamie.a12.blend`, CC BY 4.0 derivative of "Child" by gelmi.com.br) was **only opened read-only
for the same-scale lineup render**; none of its geometry, textures or data is in this character.

Files: `chr.jamie-mother.blend` (editable source), `textures/` (sources), `build-stats.json`, and the game asset
`dist/assets/chr/chr.jamie-mother.glb`. Licence: Last Light project work (no third-party terms apply).
